about: The Law Offices of Michael Dreishpoon works from Queens Boulevard in Forest Hills and practises injury work alongside criminal defence. Its about page is headed Attorney Profile and names nobody on it, so the firm names no attorney on the pages we could read, which is what G5 asks for.

462 reviews at 4.9, and twenty-three years by its domain registration, the longest of the new entries. Contingency fees, a free consultation, a 24 hour line and pages in Spanish. It publishes no case results we could read.
